acceleration_stress: No new stress set or graphs in this independent evaluation; synthetic tests only during implementation.
aggregation: Window-weighted criteria as Stage1. Also20 seed-equal metrics and paired seed-bootstrap MAE differences, sampling same reset/noise index jointly across model/source/profile/estimator. Missing coverage or undefined denominator fails; no NaN JSON.
decision_steps: 20,24,... through last available complete observation window; includes actual moving phases beyond80; this does not resume or extend the stopped controller
design: Estimator-only offline replay of newly collected actual MuJoCo cube trajectories. Clean-observation frozen R1/R4 policies generate motion independently of candidate estimates. Replay identical observed trajectories/noise to both estimators; no estimator controls actions. No grasp success labels recorded or analyzed.
detection_definition: Legacy actual switch at or after40 into desired interval; report already-correct-at40 separately. No switch by trajectory end is a miss. Overlapping windows are dependent.

kalman.initial_covariance: position variance R per candidate; velocity variance0.1²; zero covariance

estimators.position_variance: sqrt(mean(axis sample variance ddof1)), same previous estimator
estimators.second_difference_MAD: d=diff(y,n=2,axis=0); per-axis median absolute deviation around median(d); sigma_axis=MAD/(0.6744897501960817*sqrt(6)); pool sqrt(mean(sigma_axis**2)). 18 correlated differences from20 observations; no empirical tuning or finite-sample correction.

forbidden: No training, no Final grasp evaluation, no historical edits, no threshold tuning, no restarting failed study.
input_restriction: Only finite noisy cube XY array shape(20,2); no truth, sigma, RNG seed, labels or motion annotation.
limitations: Second differences cancel affine motion but not acceleration/impacts. IID Gaussian sensor noise has variance6*sigma² after difference, with correlated adjacent differences. MAD assumes centered Gaussian scale and may underestimate at n18. Noise transitions yield mixed heteroskedastic windows. Offline replay does not establish closed-loop reliability.
metrics: MAE and bias vs window injected RMS sigma; classification at7.5mm for pure windows only; false switch decisions and actual hysteresis switches at fixed7.5initial /6.5/8.5mm. Mixed windows reported separately. Detection delay at dynamic change from first appropriate actual switch; misses separate. Position-shared paired episode bootstrap conditional on policies.
motion_diagnostic: Post-estimation maximum pairwise true XY diameter: stationary<=1mm, moving>1mm. Also true acceleration RMS and XYZ diameter. Ground truth only after estimates generated.

pass_criteria.coverage: At least100 moving pure-noise windows for each0/10mm and100 stationary pure windows each; all120 complete independent trajectories and480 paired sequences

pass_criteria_reuse: Exact copy of source Stage1 pass_criteria; apply every gate to each estimator with position as relative-MAE baseline. Position baseline necessarily fails the25% relative-improvement gate. Only Kalman all-pass is candidate acceptance; no automatic control experiment.
stage2: Not implemented or authorized here; separate preregistration and decision required after independent diagnostic results. No Final-based retuning.
study: Independent estimator diagnostic Final: fixed CV Kalman vs position variance and second-difference MAD
